name: Soil, water, gas, flame, magnet and pulse sensors
author: Bench Workshop
description: Sensors for the world around a project: soil moisture (capacitive), water level, MQ-2 gas and smoke (with its warm-up), an IR flame sensor, a hall-effect magnet sensor and a pulse (heartbeat) sensor. What they sense is set in the run panel while it runs: how wet the soil is, how much gas, a finger on the pulse sensor.

parts.name: Soil moisture sensor (capacitive)
parts.description: A capacitive probe for plant pots: AOUT falls the wetter the soil is (about 2.4 V dry to 1.2 V soaked on 3.3-5 V). Read it with analogRead. Set how wet the soil is in the run panel.

parts.name: Water level sensor
parts.description: A strip of copper traces: dipped in water its S pin rises with the depth (0-4 cm), as an analog value. Set the water's depth in the run panel. (Powered all the time, the traces corrode in real life: power it from a pin and only read now and then.)

parts.name: Gas and smoke sensor (MQ-2)
parts.description: Senses smoke, LPG and methane: AO rises with the gas (analogRead), DO goes LOW past the level set by its little knob (Threshold). Its heater takes about 150 mA at 5 V and needs about 20 seconds to warm up before its readings mean anything. Set the gas in the air in the run panel.

parts.name: Flame sensor (IR)
parts.description: Sees the infrared of a flame in front of it (up to about 80 cm): AO falls the stronger the flame (analogRead), DO goes LOW past the level its knob sets. Light a flame in the run panel (how strong / how close).

controls.label: A flame in front of it (0 none, 100 close and bright)

parts.name: Magnet sensor (hall effect)
parts.description: Feels a magnetic field: AO is half its supply with no magnet and moves up or down with a magnet's north or south pole near it (about 14 mV per mT, a 49E chip), DO goes LOW when a south pole is close (as the KY-003 / A3144). Bring a magnet near in the run panel.

parts.name: Pulse sensor (heartbeat)
parts.description: Shines green light into a fingertip and sees each heartbeat as a bump in the light coming back: S is an analog wave around half the supply, a peak per beat (analogRead it fast and count the peaks). Put a finger on it and set the heart rate in the run panel.
